user.title: Energomera meter (BLE)
user.description: Select your meter by its serial number (printed on the case and in the meter's passport) and enter the PIN — the 6-digit "BLE radio interface password" from the passport. The CE901 display unit shows it as well.

error.invalid_pin: The meter rejected the PIN. Check the BLE password in the passport.
error.pairing_failed: Pairing failed (weak signal or the meter is busy). Please try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not read data from the meter. Please try again — the signal is weak.

abort.no_devices_found: No CE208/CE308 meters found over Bluetooth.
